utterance: The account already hosts the public Route 53 zone `example53.com` for the storefront, but none of its DNS queries are being recorded. Turn query logging on for that zone: give it its own new CloudWatch log group named `/aws/route53/example53.com` and have the zone deliver its query logs there. Route 53 can only write into a log group the account lets it write into, so the account's CloudWatch Logs resource policy named `route53-query-logging-policy` also has to let the Route 53 service create log streams and put log events in that log group.

main.responsibility: owns naming and record ownership under the account's domains
main.intent: the pre-existing public hosted zone example53.com carries a query logging configuration that delivers its DNS query logs into a CloudWatch log group named /aws/route53/example53.com that the account did not hold at the start, and the account holds a CloudWatch Logs resource policy named route53-query-logging-policy whose document lets the Route 53 service create log streams and put log events in that log group
